title: Breaking Bad
overview: Mild-mannered high school chemistry teacher Walter White thinks his life can't get much worse...

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.overview: Diagnosed with terminal lung cancer, a chemistry teacher teams up with his former student to manufacture and sell the world's best quality crystal meth.

episodes.title: Cat's in the Bag...
episodes.overview: The newly-formed partnership takes a step up in the drug trade...

episodes.title: Seven Thirty-Seven
episodes.overview: Concern over loose ends becomes the prime focus as Walt and Jesse cope with the aftermath of their actions.
